item.text:
Fixed `links.with_query` using standard-library `urlencode`. It correctly encodes special characters, preserves existing query text, fragments, and mapping order, and leaves URLs unchanged for empty mappings.

Added five regression tests; all passed with `python3 -m unittest -v test_links`. `git diff --check` also passed. No dependencies added.
